phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F6 Phase A — Insurance, Pensions and Standardised Guarantees Coverage Audit
purpose: Audit direct total-F6 QSA who-to-whom coverage and validate published F6 subcomponent decompositions before any bilateral component recovery or materialization.

subcomponents.F64: Claims of pension funds on pension managers
subcomponents.F66: Provisions for calls under standardised guarantees
subcomponents.F63_F64_F65: Combined pension/manager/non-pension-benefit block used in the ESA transmission programme

promotion_rule: Phase A classifies direct total-F6 source coverage and aggregate decomposition consistency only. Any component-level bilateral recovery, issuer-applicability rule, rank analysis or materialization requires a later gate.
negative_result_rule: If direct bilateral F6 is absent, aggregate totals may constrain a later component/rank gate but must never be distributed across counterparties.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; behavioural closure remains inactive.
